svg.title: Zava Forward executive architecture
svg.desc: One workflow. Evidence first. People decide.. Zava Forward / executive architecture / PR #68 / 14 October 2026. Connect staff, evidence and bounded AI support. Keep resident choice and accountable approval with people.. Solution overview / synthetic exercise. Microsoft Entra ID. Microsoft sign-in / role-limited access. HUMAN. Staff assist residents. Phone, letter, officer help Record resident choice No resident portal needed. OBSERVED. Azure Container Apps. One staff workbench + controlled workflow Rules, permissions and human review Five bounded assists in this same API. CONDITIONAL. Azure OpenAI. Draft text, citations and usage No workflow or SQL credentials Five-assistant authority is OFF. HUMAN. People own approval. Consent / independent QA Finance / work release. OBSERVED. Azure SQL. Cases, decisions and audit Proposals + usage. CONFIGURED. Azure Blob Storage. Document files Hashes + metadata in SQL. Stock / assessment / funding / coordination / quality evidence. Current evidence, not autonomous operation. Five operator model paths and SQL restart persistence observed. Normal five-assistant authority absent; proactive scans OFF. Manual case work remains available.. Intended value: less chasing, fewer evidence gaps. Human consent, safety, quality and Finance gates stay in place. Benefits need paired measurement; no production approval. M365 and separate workers are not prerequisites for this core.. Solid green: documented core interaction / Blue: configured dependency / Purple dashed: conditional model path. Work. Scoped call Draft only

g.text: One workflow. Evidence first. People decide.
Zava Forward / executive architecture / PR #68 / 14 October 2026
Connect staff, evidence and bounded AI support.
